entry.title: The level of expert decision-making is far from what society expects, and there…
entry.summary:
Source: @javadimr

The level of expert decision-making is far from what society expects, and there is no intention to persuade the public. Therefore, in wartime conditions, the most reasonable and least costly path is to avoid any manipulation of the status quo—whether regarding gasoline in Kerman, the new decision on student meals, or the misrepresentation of influence in the parliamentary bill.

entry.title: Trump has talked nonsense about annexing the Strait of Hormuz to America. But…
entry.summary:
Source: @javadimr

Trump has talked nonsense about annexing the Strait of Hormuz to America. But those whose entire being is filled with hatred for the Islamic Republic—how far are they willing to go in supporting Trump? The collective nationalist spirit of Iranians will react to the disregard of regime-change advocates for Iran's national territory, just as it eliminated the MKO.

entry.title: More than 30% defend the system and less than 20% seek its overthrow. But half…
entry.summary:
Source: @javadimr

More than 30% defend the system and less than 20% seek its overthrow. But half of society is critical of it and, frightened by it, seeks a middle path for a better life. This half—which has neither representatives nor media nor belief in its own power—is pressured by both sides: if you're not with us, you're against us.

entry.title: Manipulating society is forbidden! Mohammad Reza Javadi Yeganeh is a sociology…
entry.summary:
Source: @javadimr

Manipulating society is forbidden! Mohammad Reza Javadi Yeganeh is a sociology professor at the University of Tehran and has conducted numerous detailed social studies on Iranian society. He believes that a large part of Iran's social problems are the product of the government's manipulation of society. He even considers Iran's 1979 Islamic Revolution to be a product of this governmental manipulation. Watch the interview: https://youtu.be/t1VMLEgrdKU He believes that if society is not manipulated by the government, social forces can gradually live alongside one another and society can achieve its own stability and security. #Javadi_Yeganeh #Sociology #Social_Identity #Hijab_Issue #Social_Life @Irantalk_sn

entry.summary:
Source: @javadimr

The story of the gruesome murder of the late eulogist is still unclear; but the alignment of the far right on both ends of the spectrum—who are waiting for and benefiting from chaos in Iran—is frightening: on one side, regime-change advocates celebrate the killing of a pro-regime figure, and on the other, domestic hardliners consider all opponents, even critics of "this method of execution," as accomplices in his murder.

entry.title: In the middle of the fourteenth government's term, regardless of positive or…
entry.summary:
Source: @javadimr

In the middle of the fourteenth government's term, regardless of positive or negative views on the government's performance, the distinguishing and rare point of this government is "proper management of the country during wartime." This successful aspect of the recent war has neither been well seen nor accepted, because the country's official media system has not had and does not have the will to detail this successful performance.

The ideal of the Constitutional Revolution was the rule of law, freedom, and equality. And all four ideals are still the goal of Iranians' collective endeavor.

entry.title: Must political power change first so that social relations can be repaired, or…
entry.summary:
Source: @javadimr

Must political power change first so that social relations can be repaired, or is no lasting change in power possible without beginning to repair social relations? The reasonable answer is probably not in choosing one and eliminating the other. Freedom from domination and the ability to build, justice and care, exposing the source of harm and accepting individual responsibility, must be pursued simultaneously. A society that only engages in pathology will gradually become convinced of its own incapacity; a society that only speaks of kindness may become blind to the reality of power and injustice. In the following, you will read a note examining and critiquing the views of Hossein Janati and Ehsan Abdipour in a conversation with Dr. Mehdi Ahmadi on the "Azad" media outlet. #Psychiatric_Experiences

entry.title: Iranian society is different from what the political system expects and can…
entry.summary:
Source: @javadimr

Iranian society is different from what the political system expects and can identify and understand. It is different, but it is not frightening or dangerous. Being upset by the recent widespread reception of teenagers and young people toward Nima Taki Do and restricting the page of this million-follower audience is a sign of fear of the incomprehensible. Leaving society alone is far better than emotional reactions and manipulations.

"Why is public opinion not important to these politicians?" 👤 A conversation with Dr. #MohammadReza_JavadiYeganeh, sociologist and faculty member of the Faculty of Social Sciences at the University of Tehran 💬 In Iran, public opinion is not used for direct change in policy and is usually used to prove the correctness of previous decisions.
